hero.heading: M-350 Titanium Dioxide for Multi-Application Evaluation
paragraphs: M-350 is a general-grade rutile titanium dioxide pigment produced by the chloride process for evaluation in decorative, industrial and automotive coatings, printing inks and plastics.
The M-350 Technical Data Sheet identifies hue and gloss, hiding power, dispersibility, and weather and temperature resistance as factors to review during product screening.
Use the technical data below and confirm final performance in your own formulation, processing, application and end-use conditions.
summary: Rutile titanium dioxide pigment · Chloride process

positioning.heading: Where M-350 Fits in Product Evaluation
paragraphs: M-350 is a general-grade rutile titanium dioxide pigment for buyers evaluating one Grade across several formulation types. The M-350 TDS describes particle-size control, inorganic treatment with aluminum and zirconium compounds, and compound organic treatment.

Use M-350's listed features and technical data to decide whether it should enter testing for your coating, ink or plastics system. Final Grade selection should account for the complete formulation, pigment loading, dispersion process, substrate or polymer, application method, processing conditions, service environment and destination-document requirements.
facts: Inorganic treatment with aluminum and zirconium compounds
TDS-listed evaluation directions across coatings, printing inks and plastics
Buyer evaluation of optical, dispersion, durability and processing requirements

items.title: Decorative Coatings
items.body: Evaluate M-350 in the intended decorative coating formulation. Confirm hue, gloss, hiding power, dispersion and finished appearance at the planned pigment loading, film build and application conditions.

items.title: Industrial Coatings
items.body: Review M-350 in the complete industrial coating system. Test dispersion, hiding target, surface appearance and finished performance using the intended substrate, curing or drying process, and service conditions.

items.title: Automotive Coatings
items.body: Include M-350 in formulation testing for the intended automotive coating system. Confirm color direction, gloss, hiding power, dispersion and finished-film performance under the actual application and curing conditions.

items.title: Printing Inks
items.body: Evaluate M-350 in the buyer's ink formulation and printing process. Review dispersion, color and hiding targets, print appearance and compatibility with the selected vehicle, additives and production conditions.

items.title: Plastics
items.body: Test M-350 in the intended polymer formulation and processing system. Confirm dispersion, opacity and appearance at the planned pigment loading, additive package, processing temperature and end-use conditions.

paper.title: Additional Paper Evaluation Path
paper.body: Paper is an additional evaluation path for M-350. The M-350 TDS does not provide paper-specific performance detail, so confirm the intended paper furnish, coating or converting system, processing conditions and target properties during technical review.

evaluation.heading: What to Evaluate in Your Formulation

groups.heading: Optical and Dispersion Review
items: Hue and gloss against the finished-appearance target
Hiding power at the intended pigment loading and film, print or polymer conditions
Dispersibility in the selected binder, ink vehicle or polymer system
Finished appearance and consistency under the intended production process

groups.heading: Durability and Process Qualification
items: Weather-resistance requirements under the intended service conditions
Temperature-resistance requirements under the actual processing and end-use conditions
Compatibility with the complete formulation, additives, substrate or polymer
Application method, process settings, destination requirements and sample-validation results

evaluation.disclaimer: These priorities identify what to test during buyer evaluation. They do not guarantee a fixed result in every formulation, process, application or service environment.
